This hunk is the test half of a change to `total()` in `src/cart.ts`, which sums `price * qty` across cart items. The change adds an optional percentage coupon to that function. The three new assertions check the intended behavior: a 50% coupon halves the subtotal of 6 to 3, a coupon above 100 is clamped to 100 and gives 0, and a negative coupon is clamped to 0 and leaves 6 unchanged. The existing `total` test stays as a regression check for the no-coupon path.

The subtle part is the clamping. It is a policy choice, and the test is what locks it in. Out-of-range values are clamped rather than rejected or thrown on, so a bad coupon can't produce a negative total or a discount above 100%. The test covers only the two extremes, not in-range boundaries like exactly 0 or 100, so an off-by-one in the clamp logic would pass it.
